turns.user: why are the romanian deadlifts after the squats and not before
turns.reply:
Squats go first because they're your heaviest, most technically demanding lift and need your legs and core to be completely fresh. 

RDLs come second so your lower back doesn't fatigue before your heavy squats are done. 

If your back ever feels too tired by the time you reach the RDLs, let me know and we can tweak the volume!
